chunkings.name: default
chunkings.about: today's default (#381): # to ### start a chunk; one over 4,000 characters is cut again at deeper headings

chunkings.name: h6
chunkings.about: every heading starts a chunk; nothing is merged or bounded (the default before #381)

chunkings.name: h2
chunkings.about: only # and ## start a chunk; deeper sections stay inside their parent

chunkings.name: merge-400
chunkings.about: every heading starts a chunk, then one under 400 characters is merged with the next while the result stays within 4,000

reasons: best none configuration: `bm25` at `default`: recall@5 81.7%, nDCG@10 0.705, MRR 0.651, wrong-version rate 0, p95 57 ms, $0.0000 per 1000 questions
